fullPassage: Did you know that many technologies around us originated from space technology? You may not have realized it, but we have been enjoying the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives for a long time. Let's see how some examples of it have been invented and integrated into our daily lives already. Memory foam was initially developed to minimize the effects of the force of gravity on astronauts during takeoff and landing. Memory foam absorbs shock by changing its shape in reaction to pressure, and it can change its shape to match the body shape of an astronaut. Once the pressure is lifted, memory foam gradually returns to its original shape, as if it remembered its original form. Because of this characteristic, it is called "memory" foam. It provides astronauts with improved protection and comfort when they are in their seats. Since memory foam was first introduced into the public domain, it has been used in a number of products such as beds and sofas. Today's water purifier also originated from space technology. While planning their human space exploration program, NASA scientists realized that it was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water into a spacecraft. Then, they hit upon an idea that wastewater could be recycled once harmful bacteria were removed. So they developed a water purification system that could successfully kill off bacteria. Continued research led to the invention of a better water purification system that uses cartridges for longer missions that did not need to be replaced frequently. This water purifying technique was developed for several decades and then marketed for domestic use. Another everyday item developed from space technology is the air purifier. A reliable source of food was vital for survival in space. In order to get fresh food, astronauts had to cultivate crops in the spacecraft. However, there was a major obstacle. When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It accelerates the aging of plants and the decaying of fruits. Since it was impossible to exchange gas for clean air while in space, scientists developed an air purification system to remove the gas. Although the goal was to eliminate ethylene, the system could get rid of other unwanted things from the air, too. A private company recognized the potential of the air purification system and obtained a license to develop and commercialize it. The fourth invention is the wireless headset. It was devised after an unexpected incident NASA had experienced. The second manned spacecraft launched by the U.S. completed its mission and successfully landed in the Atlantic Ocean. The command pilot was waiting for the recovery team that would get him and the capsule from the ocean. Everything was going smoothly until unexpectedly, the capsule started to leak. Water flooded into the cabin before the team arrived, and the pilot had to escape, abandoning all of the spacecraft's radio communications equipment. This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team. He was left floating in the ocean until he succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter's attention. After this accident, NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station. Later, wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world. These days, Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets. Now we can connect headsets wirelessly with mobile digital devices such as smartphones and laptops. In our daily lives, there are many other inventions that have their origins in space technology including the smartphone camera and the computer mouse. Private firms as well as government organizations have invested heavily in space technology for space exploration. Therefore, we can expect that our future lives will be significantly influenced by space technology that has not yet been invented.

조종사는 모든 무선 통신 장비를 가지고 안전하게 탈출했다.

questions.passage: Another everyday item developed from space technology is the air purifier. A reliable source of food was vital for survival in space. In order to get fresh food, astronauts had to cultivate crops in the spacecraft. However, there was a major obstacle. When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It accelerates the aging of plants and the decaying of fruits. Since it was impossible to exchange gas for clean air while in space, scientists developed an air purification system to remove the gas. Although the goal was to eliminate ethylene, the system could get rid of other unwanted things from the air, too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 공기 청정기의 유래.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 본문 'A private company recognized the potential of the air purification system and obtained a license to develop and commercialize it'와 일치 ←정답

❌ ② 본문 'it was impossible to exchange gas for clean air while in space'에서 '불가능'했다고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ③ 본문 'Although the goal was to eliminate ethylene, the system could get rid of other unwanted things from the air, too'에서 다른 것도 제거할 수 있었다고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ④ 본문 'astronauts had to cultivate crops in the spacecraft'에서 작물을 재배해야 했다고 했으므로 '포기'는 불일치
det.tip: private company ~ obtained a license(민간 기업이 라이선스 획득)가 일치. 나머지는 본문과 반대입니다.

ch: 한 민간 기업이 공기 정화 시스템의 잠재력을 알아보고 개발·상업화 라이선스를 획득했다.
우주에서는 가스를 깨끗한 공기로 쉽게 교환할 수 있었다.
공기 정화 시스템은 에틸렌만 제거할 수 있었고 다른 것은 제거하지 못했다.
신선한 식품을 얻기 위해 우주비행사들은 작물 재배를 포기해야 했다.

questions.passage: Today's water purifier also originated from space technology. While planning their human space exploration program, NASA scientists realized that it was impossible ①<u>to load</u> a sufficient amount of clean water into a spacecraft. Then, they hit upon an idea that wastewater could be ②<u>recycling</u> once harmful bacteria were removed. So they developed a water purification system that could successfully kill off bacteria. Continued research led to the invention of a better water purification system that ③<u>uses</u> cartridges for longer missions that did not need to be replaced frequently. This water purifying technique was developed for several decades and then ④<u>marketed</u> for domestic use.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② recycling → recycled: 'could be + 과거분사'의 수동태이므로 recycled
det.analysis:
① to load: 'it was impossible to load a sufficient amount of clean water'에서 'it ~ to부정사'의 진주어 to load가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② recycling → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'wastewater could be ___ once harmful bacteria were removed'에서 폐수가 '재활용될 수 있다'는 수동의 의미예요. 'could be + 과거분사'의 조동사 수동태라 과거분사 recycled로 써야 해요. recycling(현재분사)은 능동이라 틀려요. ❌ recycling은 틀림 ←정답

③ uses: 'a system that uses cartridges'에서 선행사 system(단수)을 받는 주격 관계대명사절의 단수 동사 uses가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ marketed: 'was ~ marketed for domestic use'에서 '판매되었다'는 수동태라 과거분사 marketed가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 조동사 수동태 could be + 과거분사: could be recycled(재활용될 수 있다)

questions.passage: Another everyday item developed from space technology is the air purifier. A reliable source of food was vital for survival in space. In order to get fresh food, astronauts had to cultivate crops in the spacecraft. However, there was a major obstacle. When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It accelerates the aging of plants and the decaying of fruits. Since it was impossible to exchange gas for clean air while in space, scientists developed an air purification system to remove the gas. Although the goal was to eliminate ethylene, the system could get rid of other unwanted things from the air, too.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 식물이 자랄 때 생성되어 식물의 노화와 과일의 부패를 가속하는 기체의 이름을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 작물 재배를 방해하는 기체.
det.analysis: 본문 'When plants grow, ethylene gas is produced. It accelerates the aging of plants and the decaying of fruits.'에서 식물이 자랄 때 생성되어 노화와 부패를 가속하는 기체는 ethylene(에틸렌)이다.
det.tip: ethylene gas is produced ~ It accelerates ~에서 ethylene을 찾습니다.

questions.passage: The fourth invention is the wireless headset. It was devised after an unexpected incident NASA had experienced. The second manned spacecraft launched by the U.S. completed its mission and successfully landed in the Atlantic Ocean. The command pilot was waiting for the recovery team that would get him and the capsule from the ocean. Everything was going smoothly until unexpectedly, the capsule started to leak. Water flooded into the cabin before the team arrived, and the pilot had to escape, abandoning all of the spacecraft's radio communications equipment. This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team. He was left floating in the ocean until he succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter's attention. After this accident, NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station. Later, wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, NASA와 협력사가 개발한 헬멧의 무선 시스템이 통신할 수 있도록 지정된 대상을 가리키는 두 단어 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 무선 통신 시스템의 통신 대상.
det.analysis: 본문 'NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station.'에서 헬멧의 무선 시스템이 통신할 수 있도록 지정된 대상은 base station(기지국)이다.
det.tip: communicate with a designated base station에서 base station을 찾습니다.

questions.passage: Private firms as well as government organizations have __________ (invest) heavily in space technology for space exploration. Therefore, we can expect that our future lives will be significantly influenced by space technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: invested (현재완료의 과거분사).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'have ___ heavily in space technology'에서 앞에 조동사 역할의 have가 있으므로 'have + 과거분사'의 현재완료다. 과거부터 지금까지 '투자해 왔다'는 의미이므로 invest를 과거분사 invested로 바꿔야 한다. 'have invested(투자해 왔다)'로 해석된다.
det.tip: have + 과거분사(현재완료) → have invested

questions.passage: Did you know that many technologies around us originated from space technology? You may not have realized it, but we have been enjoying the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives for a long time. Let's see how some examples of it have been invented and integrated into our daily lives already. Memory foam was initially developed to minimize the effects of the force of gravity on astronauts during takeoff and landing. Memory foam absorbs shock by changing its shape in reaction to pressure, and it can change its shape to match the body shape of an astronaut. Once the pressure is lifted, memory foam gradually returns to its original shape, as if it remembered its original form. Because of this characteristic, it is called "memory" foam. It provides astronauts with improved protection and comfort when they are in their seats.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 글은 메모리폼, 정수기, 공기 청정기, 무선 헤드셋 등 우주 기술에서 비롯되어 일상생활에 쓰이는 다양한 발명품들을 다룸 ← 정답

❌ ① 드론의 역사는 본문(Read More)과 별개로, 본문 주제가 아님

❌ ② 메모리폼은 여러 예시 중 하나일 뿐 제조 공정이 주제가 아님

❌ ④ 예산 확보 방법은 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: 메모리폼·정수기·공기 청정기·무선 헤드셋을 관통하는 것이 주제입니다.

ch: 드론이 군사 목적에서 상업 목적으로 발전해 온 역사
메모리폼을 대량으로 생산하는 다양한 제조 공정
우주 기술에서 비롯되어 일상생활에 쓰이는 다양한 발명품들
우주 탐사 프로그램에 필요한 예산을 확보하는 방법

questions.passage: Did you know that many technologies around us originated from space technology? You may not have realized it, but we have been enjoying the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives for a long time. Let's see how some examples of it have been invented and integrated into our daily lives already. Memory foam was initially developed to minimize the effects of the force of gravity on astronauts during takeoff and landing. Memory foam absorbs shock by changing its shape in reaction to pressure, and it can change its shape to match the body shape of an astronaut. Once the pressure is lifted, memory foam gradually returns to its original shape, as if it remembered its original form. Because of this characteristic, it is called "memory" foam. It provides astronauts with improved protection and comfort when they are in their seats.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문은 일상생활 곳곳의 발명품을 다루므로 '군사 분야에서만'은 반대

✅ ② 본문 'we have been enjoying the enormous benefits of space technology in our daily lives'와 'our future lives will be significantly influenced by space technology that has not yet been invented'를 아우르는 핵심 메시지 ← 정답

❌ ③ 메모리폼은 여러 예시 중 하나로, 다른 것보다 중요하다는 언급은 없음

❌ ④ 정수기의 가정용·우주선용 사용량 비교는 본문에 없음
det.tip: 일상의 편의가 우주 기술에서 비롯됐고 미래에도 영향받는다는 것이 요지입니다.

ch: 우주 기술은 군사 분야에서만 유용하게 쓰인다.
우리가 일상에서 누리는 많은 편의가 우주 기술에서 비롯되었으며, 미래의 삶도 우주 기술에 크게 영향받을 것이다.
메모리폼은 다른 어떤 우주 기술보다 중요한 발명품이다.
정수기는 가정용보다 우주선용으로 더 많이 사용된다.

The second manned spacecraft launched by the U.S. completed its mission and successfully landed in the Atlantic Ocean. The command pilot was waiting for the recovery team that would get him and the capsule from the ocean. Everything was going smoothly until unexpectedly, the capsule started to leak. Water flooded into the cabin before the team arrived, and the pilot had to escape, abandoning all of the spacecraft's radio communications equipment. __________. He was left floating in the ocean until he succeeded in visibly getting the rescue helicopter's attention. After this accident, NASA and a partner company developed helmets equipped with a radio system that could communicate with a designated base station. Later, wireless headsets using this system were introduced to the world. These days, Bluetooth technology has been incorporated into wireless headsets.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"이것이 그가 회수팀과 통신하는 것을 막았다." (9단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) communicating, from, him, prevented, recovery, team, the, this, with 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team
det.analysis:
주어는 This이고, 과거 본동사는 prevented예요: This + prevented.

'그가 ~하는 것을 막았다'는 'prevent + 목적어(him) + from + 동명사' 구문이에요: him + from + communicating.

'회수팀과'는 with the recovery team으로 마무리해요: with + the + recovery + team.

순서대로 이으면 This / prevented / him / from / communicating / with / the / recovery / team.
det.tip: prevent A from -ing(A가 ~하는 것을 막다): prevented him from communicating

questions.wa: This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team
accept: This prevented him from communicating with the recovery team
